failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017) AS orders_2017,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018) AS orders_2018,
       ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018) - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017), 0), 2) AS growth_rate
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017) > 0
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 12;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT member_id, level_id
  FROM (
    SELECT member_id,
           level_id,

    FROM member_snapshot
  ) t

SELECT m.level_id AS current_level_id,
       s.level_id AS snapshot_level_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count

WHERE m.level_id <> s.level_id
